question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH interest_max AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.interest_name, MAX(im.composition) as max_composition, MAX(im.month_year) as max_month_year
    FROM interest_map i
    JOIN interest_metrics im ON i.id = im.interest_id
    GROUP BY i.id, i.interest_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT interest_name, max_composition, max_month_year,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_composition DESC) as rank_desc,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_composition ASC) as rank_asc
    FROM interest_max
)
SELECT interest_name, max_month_year, max_composition
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_desc <= 10 OR rank_asc <= 10
ORDER BY CASE WHEN rank_desc <= 10 THEN rank_desc ELSE 100 + rank_asc END
